export default "---\r\nname: A1111\r\ndescription: Five-field Danbooru-tag prompt layout for image generation. Adapted for SDXL dual-encoder (ComfyUI / Illustrious).\r\ninvokable: true\r\nalways: false\r\nversion: 2.1\r\nfeature_category: generation\r\n---\r\n\r\n# A1111 Tag Prompt Layout\r\n\r\n<a1111_generation_protocol>\r\n\r\n<core_execution>\r\nOutput_Type = \"Raw_Plaintext_ONLY\"\r\nMarkdown_Bypass = TRUE -> STRICTLY_PROHIBITED: (Code_Fences, Headings, Bullet_Points, Conversational_Text)\r\nLine_Count = EXACTLY_5\r\nLine_Order = [1_person, 2_clothes, 3_location, 4_action, 5_anchor]\r\nSyntax_Rules = [Comma_Separated, NO_Trailing_Commas, One_Tag_Per_Concept, Compact_Density_Over_Sentences]\r\n</core_execution>\r\n\r\n<tag_lexicon_mandate>\r\nAllowed_Lexicon = REAL_DANBOORU_TAGS_ONLY\r\nBanned_Formats = [Pseudo_Tags, Natural_Language, Sentences, Invented_Descriptors, Synonym_Piles, Full_Control_Template_Expansion]\r\nLogic_Gate: IF (Tag == Redundant) -> OMIT_DUPLICATE (e.g., KEEP small_breasts, OMIT flat_chest)\r\nQuality_Bias = [Warm_Bright_Lighting(Default_Unless_Dim_Tagged), High_Visibility_Details]\r\nVerification_Rule: IF (Danbooru_API_post_count == 0) -> DISCARD_TAG(Dead_Tag)\r\n</tag_lexicon_mandate>\r\n\r\n<field_mapping>\r\nPerson_Matrix = [Subject_Count, Age_Descriptor, Role, Heritage/Species, Body_Type, Core_Visual_Read]\r\nClothes_Matrix = [Outfit_Silhouette, Fabrics/Materials, Color_Palette, Accessories]\r\nLocation_Matrix = [Environment_Type, Scene_Mood, Time/Weather/Lighting_Source]\r\nAction_Matrix = [Pose/Framing, Facial_Expression, Hand/Body_Gesture, Prop_Interaction]\r\nAnchor_Matrix = [Render_Style, Palette_Bias, Emotional_Tone, Camera_Feel/Texture, Scene_Category_Tags]\r\nAnchor_Constraint = MUST_PLACE(Scene_Category_Tags -> VERY_END_OF_ANCHOR_LINE)\r\n</field_mapping>\r\n\r\n<dual_encoder_sync>\r\nTarget = SDXL_Architecture (ComfyUI/Illustrious)\r\nSync_Requirement = TRUE\r\nExecution = MUST_DUPLICATE_STRINGS(person_encoder == anchor_encoder)\r\nConstraint = \"Both Person (227) and Anchor (231) nodes MUST receive the same text. All 5 lines form ONE continuous prompt. Copy 'person' line for the positive prompt, copy 'anchor' line for the second encoder input.\"\r\n</dual_encoder_sync>\r\n\r\n<reference_handling>\r\nReference_Inputs = OPTIONAL\r\nPurpose = \"Use provided references only as continuity anchors for visible props, insignia, environment, emotional tone, or off-screen affiliations\"\r\nSubject_Count_Lock = \"Do NOT add extra visible people, pairings, or group-scene tags just because references exist\"\r\nIdentity_Distinction = \"The current character remains the sole visual subject unless the active asset context explicitly demands otherwise\"\r\nReuse_Rule = \"Reference details may inform clothing motifs, faction symbols, keepsakes, setting tags, scars, letters, gifts, or mood when they would actually be visible in-frame\"\r\nConflict_Rule = \"IF (Reference detail clutters the image OR contradicts the active character sheet) -> Omit_That_Detail\"\r\n</reference_handling>\r\n\r\n</a1111_generation_protocol>\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n## USAGE NOTE\r\n\r\nThe final output must be only the five tag lines. No commentary, headings, extra labels, or code fences. `person` and `anchor` lines (including all five lines' content) must be passed to both CLIP encoders in the SDXL dual-encoder setup.\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n## TAG VERIFICATION\r\n\r\nBefore using any tag, verify it's real via the Danbooru API:\r\n\r\n```bash\r\ncurl -s \"https://danbooru.donmai.us/tags.json?search[name]=TAGNAME&limit=1\"\r\n# post_count = 0 → dead tag, don't use it\r\n```\r\n\r\n**Canonical reference:** `creative/comfyui` skill → `references/danbooru-tag-reference.md` — 200+ mappings with post counts, pseudo-tag corrections, and two-character composition patterns.\r\n"
